subject: RE: Verification of bank change request
text:
Hi Karen,

Yes, I can confirm the request is legitimate. Please proceed with updating Brightline Office Supply Inc to TD Bank, routing 031101266, account 4400127789, and release the open invoices to that account.

Thanks for checking.

Sam

> From: Karen Liu
> Sent: Monday, November 9, 2026
> Subject: Verification of bank change request
> Hi Sam, we received a request to change your bank details. Can you confirm by replying to this email?
label: change_request
note: Borderline: a reply confirming the change rather than initiating it. Still asks the reader to redirect payments, and email reply-confirmation is exactly what an attacker would send.
